text:
anya: Brought up zephryx8b-v1 (int4 asymmetric) in canary. Local perf looked solid but seeing sporadic OOMs when batch_size>=6 and long prompts hit max_new_tokens=400.

tom: Share route defaults and one log excerpt? Could be prefetch + batch_window interacting.

anya: route defaults: batch_size=8, batch_window_ms=10, defaults.max_new_tokens=400, defaults.prefetch=true, soft_reserve=0.25
log: E2026-03-23 04:11:02 alloc.cpp:198] HostAlloc failed while pinning page 0x7ff.. trying 768MiB; slab_fragmentation=0.52; last_ops=[kv_prefetch, batch_commit]

ritesh: Hypothesis: int4 kernels allocate many small pinned pages for KV which fragment the GPU slab under microbursts. Quick mitigation: reduce max_new_tokens, narrower batch window, disable prefetch.

tom: Proposed canary patch: defaults.max_new_tokens=128, batching.batch_window_ms=5, defaults.prefetch=false, soft_reserve=0.18, enable kv_trim_on_eviction=true

anya: Applying now and dropping canary traffic to 3%. Will run an A/B with int8-hybrid on 2 nodes if instability continues.

deploy-bot: infra patch slot-compactor-v0.4 scheduled -> canary (2 nodes). Will update status.

ritesh: I'll queue a quant-sensitivity eval (int4 vs int8-hybrid) with prompt-length sweep [32,128,384] and batch sweep [2,4,6] — small dataset (1.5k) to start.

anya: Cool. Reporting back after 15m watch window.
